scientific.integrity: The two-task minimax ball problem is solved by its active linear branch and then by orthogonal projection onto the equal-progress hyperplane; all thresholds follow by exact algebra.
limitations: Unequal-norm theorem is restricted to the regime where the mean harms the weaker task.
Clipped or weighted variants are not covered.

title: Two-task CAGrad has sharp common-descent and equalization thresholds
